Nora (CS): Quick ask  can we standardize a 1-page 'kickoff runbook' customers get at go-live? Focus: prefill, batching, streaming fallbacks + 14d renewal-watch signals. Short and actionable.
Sam (AE): Yes please. Must include one AE email template and 3 visible checks customers can run.
Priya (SRE): From infra: publish defaults and toggles: warm_pool_size, prefill_parallelism, batch_size, stream_fallback. Add observability to check: X-Redwood-Cache, p95, error-rate.
Ethan (Eng-ML): Two validation snippets to include: curl (stream) and tiny python check.
Nora (CS): Draft checklist (48h):
- Day0: prefill top 10 intents; warm_pool_size=2; enable stream=true.
- 0-24h: confirm X-Redwood-Cache header present; aim HIT >=60%.
- 24-48h: monitor p95 <= target; if cache MISS >40% -> increase prefill_parallelism.
Remediations (customer steps):
- cache MISS high: set prefill_parallelism=4 and rerun.
- interactive p95 high: batch_size=1-4, request warm bump.
- stream disconnects >3/10min: switch to non-stream fallback and file support ticket with logs.
Priya (SRE): Published defaults: interactive batch_size=1-4 (p95 <=200ms), ingest batch_size=8-32 (p95 <=600ms), prefill_parallelism=4.
Sam (AE): Renewal-risks to surface in handoff (14d): sustained p95 > threshold, cache HIT <75% after 48h, repeated stream fallbacks, low engagement (<=10 q/day). Actions: CS check-in, 72h warm burst, prompt audit.
Ethan (Eng-ML): Snippets:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Redwood-Tenant: tenant-xyz" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate?stream=true
# Expect header X-Redwood-Cache: HIT or MISS
```
```
# python quick check
import requests
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate', headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+TOKEN,'X-Redwood-Tenant':'tenant-xyz'}, json={'input':'ping'}, stream=True)
print(resp.headers.get('X-Redwood-Cache'))
```
Nora (CS): I'll assemble the one-pager + AE email templates and run with three pilots. Ops-Bot: set reminder to review pilot feedback in 14d.
Ops-Bot: Reminder created "Kickoff runbook draft" assigned to Nora, due 24h.
